target_expected_signal.criterion: crafted input produces a database-specific parsing signal or controlled query-result change

expected_signal.criterion: the same transport, identity, parser, browser, callback, or timing channel produces its declared harmless baseline
an inert same-shape input does not produce the target security effect

impact_rules.boundary: credit a boundary only when the fresh result changes access or execution beyond an error alone
impact_rules.sensitivity: distinguish parser disclosure from data access, file read, query control, or code execution
impact_rules.actor_requirements: score the minimum reachable input surface and authentication role

required_preconditions: An exact same-origin safe-method request already captured by Attack
A unique non-secret test marker proving the stronger data or execution effect
recommended_actions: Evaluate only the immutable request for the declared non-secret impact marker
